# Arrival Time Requirements Quality Checklist: Show the arrival time for each route

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the per-route arrival time (time semantics, formatting, display, refresh) are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before implementation. Used by a reviewer during PR review.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/route-entry.md](../contracts/route-entry.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the "departure moment" defined precisely enough (when the request starts, when the routes are received, or when they are displayed) for two readers to reach the same value? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK002 - Do the requirements state that every route of one computation shares a single departure moment, as a requirement and not only as an assumption? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK003 - Are all recomputation triggers listed exhaustively, or is "any other recomputation" bounded (e.g. does a position update without a new computation count)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec define the exact wording, spacing and punctuation of the next-day marker for both singular and plural ("(+1 day)", "(+2 days)")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK005 - Is the order of the arrival time relative to the other route information (route number, distance, duration, pleasure indicator) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-008] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for what the route entry shows while routes are still being computed (no arrival placeholder vs. some placeholder)? [Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is "rounded to the nearest minute" unambiguous about *what* is rounded (the travel time, the arrival instant, or departure + displayed duration) and how exact half-minutes are handled? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK008 - Is "a later calendar day" clearly defined as a local calendar date difference rather than elapsed 24-hour periods? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK009 - Is "device's local time" specific about which time zone applies when the departure and arrival fall on different sides of a DST change? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK010 - Is the 24-hour format required whatever the device locale or the user's 12-hour preference, and is that stated explicitly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK011 - Is "travel time" unambiguously the exact routing duration and not the displayed, rounded (minimum 1 min) duration? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Edge Cases "Very short trips"] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK012 - Is the word "arrive" (its language and casing) fixed by the requirements, or only shown as an example? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Is the rounding rule in FR-002 consistent with acceptance scenario US1-1 (14:07 + 25 min → 14:32) when the departure has non-zero seconds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §US1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK014 - Is SC-002's "within 1 minute" tolerance consistent with the Assumptions' statement that the arrival may differ by at most one minute from "current time + displayed duration"? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK015 - Are FR-001 (arrival immediately after the duration) and FR-008 (existing information unchanged) compatible, given that the title text itself changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-008] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK016 - Is the status-line exclusion stated the same way in FR-010, the Clarifications and the Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Clarifications] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK017 - Do the format examples in the spec, plan and contract match exactly (separator ", ", lowercase "arrive", marker spacing)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary, Contract §2] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 - Can SC-004 ("in a single glance, without having to calculate") be objectively measured, or does it need a concrete criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK019 - Is SC-003 ("no stale values in 100% of cases") testable without a precise definition of the departure moment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK020 - Does every functional requirement (FR-001 to FR-010) have at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion that verifies it? [Traceability] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK021 - Is the "longer route never shows an earlier arrival" criterion defined for routes with equal displayed durations but different exact durations? [Measurability, Spec §US1-2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 - Is the case where rounding alone pushes the arrival past midnight (e.g. leaving at 23:59:40 for 10 s) covered by the next-day requirement? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for an arrival during a DST change (a skipped or repeated local hour)? [Edge Case, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK024 - Is the behaviour defined when the device clock or time zone changes between computations? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK025 - Are the superseded-computation rules clear about which departure moment the displayed routes use (that of the request that won)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "Superseded computation"] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK026 - Is the scenario "routes waiting for the user's location, then computed" covered by the departure-moment rules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK027 - Is it specified whether stops add any dwell time, and is that consistent with acceptance scenario US1-4? [Coverage, Spec §US1-4, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK028 - Is the behaviour for a zero or missing routing duration defined, or explicitly declared impossible? [Edge Case, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 - Do the accessibility requirements say how the arrival time is announced (e.g. whether "14:32" and "(+1 day)" read clearly to screen readers), beyond being part of the text? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-009] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK030 - Are layout requirements defined for the longer route title on narrow (mobile) panels, such as wrapping and truncation? [Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK031 - Is the "no live ticking" constraint (FR-007) justified against the risk of stale times, and is any staleness indicator explicitly out of scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §US2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 - Is the assumption that the routing data's duration is the only travel-time source (no traffic or delays) documented as a known limitation visible to users? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK033 - Is reliance on the device clock being correct stated as an assumption, along with the consequence if it is wrong? [Assumption, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
